verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents several first-party SDKs for building on Workers. These include the Agents SDK (`npm install agents`) for stateful agents on Durable Objects, the Sandbox SDK with a concrete `getSandbox(...).exec(...)` API, the `@cloudflare/think` agent harness, the `mppx` payments SDK, and the official workers-sdk repository. Together they directly deliver the ability to build against official SDKs. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond JavaScript/TypeScript, an official client library for the Cloudflare REST API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Agents are persistent, stateful execution environments for agentic workloads, powered by Cloudflare Durable Objects.
Sandbox SDK provides a simple API for executing commands, managing files, running background processes, and exposing services — all from your Workers applications.
The Sandbox SDK enables you to run untrusted code securely in isolated environments.
`@cloudflare/think` lets you build a stateful AI chat agent — one that streams replies, remembers the conversation, and calls tools — by extending a single base class.
The mppx SDK handles payment retries for HTTP requests and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls.
A simulator for developing and testing Cloudflare Workers, powered by workerd
